floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published one to four bedroom layouts and the six bedroom penthouse. Where a sheet lists several levels with different total areas, the displayed range includes those printed values. Match the unit and level on the complete plan.
floorPlans.note: Published plans are not a statement of current inventory. Total area includes the listed balcony area; suite area is smaller. Layouts, dimensions, furnishings and illustrated outlooks may change. Confirm the selected unit and sale inclusions.
